pokedexEntries.bk: It fights by swinging a piece of lumber around. It is close to evolving when it can handle the lumber without difficulty.

pokedexEntries.wh: These Pokémon appear at building sites and help out with construction. They always carry squared logs.

pokedexEntries.b2w2: Always carrying squared logs, they help out with construction. As they grow, they carry bigger logs.

pokedexEntries.sw: It loves helping out with construction projects. It loves it so much that if rain causes work to halt, it swings its log around and throws a tantrum.

pokedexEntries.sh: Timburr that have started carrying logs that are about three times their size are nearly ready to evolve.

pokedexEntries.vi: It fights by swinging a piece of lumber around. It is close to evolving when it can handle heavy lumber without difficulty.
